title: A camera's menus (private/evidence/<model>_fw<firmware>/menu_tree_<model>_fw<firmware>.json)
description: Every row of the camera's menus, page by page, as the kit's walk read them: the Stills menu, and the other shooting modes' menus it holds. The mapper's own file, private whole and never submitted (docs/decisions/0016): which rows the walk found greyed or could not read, which option lists it read and where each began, are the state the camera stood in. kit/tools/menu_tree.py writes it; kit/schema_update.py places each setting on its rows, and the definition's menu list and places are what is public of the menus.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, relative to the file.

model.description: The camera model, as the definition names it (ILCE-1M2).

firmware.description: The firmware the menus were read on (4.00).

source.description: How the tree was made: from which runs, or by hand, and when.

tabs.description: The Stills menu: its tabs, each with its pages in the order of their counters.

modes.description: The menus of the camera's other shooting modes (Movie, S&Q), each written by kit/tools/menu_tree.py --mode from that mode's page scan and crawls; the Stills menu (tabs) is left as it is.

mode.description: The mode's name, as the camera's Still/Movie/S&Q switch says it and as the proofs' contexts name it ("[Movie mode]").

tabs.description: The mode's menu, in the shape of the Stills menu's tabs.

state.description: What the walk found: walked, submenu, greyed, never, info, button, unhandled, seen.
